P0 · Done — Lock Favorites against accidental unpin

Remark: Default lock, fresh-message pin labels and explicit API unpin acknowledgement verified by backend/browser regressions and all seven workflows at b1fcd27. Installed live Favorites contained four disabled Unpin buttons; Unlock enabled all four, then Lock disabled them. No user pins removed. Chat deletion/recovery remains separate.

P0 · Planned — Named delete warning, 24-hour recycle bin and preserved Favorites

Remark: Current delete permanently removes original turns and pins. Implement reversible chat/project deletion, exact-name warnings, 24-hour recovery/expiry, and an explicit choice to keep or remove favorite snapshots. Preserve formatting; orphaned snapshots show unavailable source links. Requires storage/restore and expiry tests before delivery.

P1 · Planned — Retry or regenerate a reply with another model

Remark: Preserve original question, attachments and chat location. Keep prior reply available, record selected model/usage and never replay executed writes. Verify interrupted replies, parallel streams and reload.

P1 · Planned — Built-in live verification browser

Remark: Prepare a scoped browser view for UI smoke checks and user-controlled credential entry. Credentials must not become model-visible. External pages can refuse embedding; use a secure companion browser when required. No embedded browser delivered yet.

P1 · Planned — Administrator-configurable chat limits

Remark: Existing simultaneous-answer limit is three and request budgets are bounded. Add explicit settings for concurrent replies and per-chat history/message limits with safe bounds, migration and clear validation errors; do not silently discard history.

P1 · Done — Simple gist first and remembered short-answer preference

Remark: Conversation-scoped brief policy persists in encrypted turn metadata and reopens without affecting other chats. Native/Responses, quoted-code/attachment isolation, reset and disabled mode passed. All seven workflows at b1fcd27 passed. Three installed live Standard-model requests saved brief, brief, normal; zero external reads and no errors. Disposable test chats removed. Model adherence is tested, not guaranteed for every response.
CI: https://github.com/abhijitxroy/aimate/actions/runs/45844203798
Latest remark: Temporary-chat preferences now remain in session memory and never enter owner turn metadata; closing clears them. Regression plus all seven workflows passed at 4950cb1. Installed server restarted with this fix.

P0 · Planned — Artifactory connection and scoped reads

Remark: Implement a separate optional connector with secure token input, URL validation, green/partial/red checks, bounded artifact metadata/search and source citations. Do not download or execute binaries implicitly; live server access needs user settings.

Priority update: required for packaging eligibility evidence. Add scoped AQL search with complete pagination, exact artifact identities, bounded report/log reads, credential and TLS handling, report content hashes and freshness. Missing or truncated search results must stay inconclusive. Acceptance: malformed reports, denied access, partial listings, wrong hosts, schema/version changes and disabled-module tests; live server validation remains separate.

P0 · Done — SQ-08 child: explicit incomplete-answer checkpoints

Parent: search-quality-08. Native/Responses lookup limits, native output limits and empty final answers save paired incomplete checkpoints; last-round pending tools/proposals are not run. P0 · Planned — Deterministic packaging/DMS evidence reconciliation

Parents: search-quality-07 and search-quality-08. Normalize cutoff timezone and freeze inclusive-start/exclusive-end build population. Compare all package-creation builds against mirror records; deduplicate by full job path/build/target. Inspect packaging stages, report result and fingerprint, DMS version/execution/startup evidence and exact Jira created/reused links. Separate infrastructure failures, non-eligible cases, startup failures, other uncovered eligible cases and inconclusive evidence. Output mutually exclusive counts plus missing-field checklist and direct build citations. Dependencies: scoped data/Artifactory access; contract and synthetic fixtures can proceed. Acceptance: complete pagination, out-of-mirror builds, duplicate/retried targets, same-number jobs, missing reports/logs, dedup reuse, stale Jira sync and arithmetic reconciliation. Remark: new business-specific task; avoid inferring eligibility or cause from existence/date proximity.

P0 · Done — Recover final findings after an empty model answer

One bounded tool-free synthesis request uses source-labelled evidence excerpts; no restarted searches, pending actions or hidden reasoning. Empty/failed recovery retains the incomplete checkpoint; recovered findings are labelled partial without fabricated scores. Plain-text saved assistant replies now render and export after reload.
Remark: Six recovery tests plus checkpoint/model regression checks and real browser reload passed. All seven workflows passed at 6fec54c. A live Sonnet test returned final findings from the failed turn evidence with no new service queries or chat-history changes; usage recorded and result protected locally. Installed app restarted and verified UI served. Runtime root cause/ownership and universal provider parity remain unverified.
CI: https://github.com/abhijitxroy/aimate/actions/runs/45868566640

P0 · WIP — Auto routing across validated AI connection profiles

Extend beyond current Standard/Analysis slots: optional encrypted profiles for Bedrock Claude/GPT, Gemini Vertex, OpenCode-backed models and eligible ChatGPT/Codex connections. Tools/clients are not themselves distinct models; avoid duplicate routes to the same backend. Separate Intel-approved and personal data permissions; never transfer protected evidence to an unapproved account. Select one eligible model per request using task type, context/vision/tool capabilities, verified access, health and explicit cost ceilings. Provide manual override, selection explanation and approved fallback; no silent expensive escalation or concurrent multi-model billing. Validate candidate invocation separately from catalog presence, preserve credential removal/revocation and fail closed when no permitted profile exists. Acceptance: provider/profile isolation, no secret exposure, revoked/expired access, deterministic routing contracts, benchmark quality and live access checks. Dependencies: multi-provider profile storage/settings and permission labels; current Auto only chooses the active provider Standard/Analysis models. Remark: new routing feature; not implemented yet.
User decision: Auto policy must be user-selectable (Balanced, Quality, Economy), alongside manual selection. First policy-selector batch is being verified within the current provider; encrypted multi-provider pool and permission/cost/health routing remain open.

Parent: cross-provider-auto-routing. Askbar Balanced/Quality/Economy choices retain manual Standard/Analysis and show the selected model; browser choice survives reload. Quality/Economy use configured slots without classifier cost. Missing/disabled policies are tested; no provider/account changes.
Remark: Three policy/API tests, routing regressions and full browser checks passed. All seven workflows passed at 57f612a; installed app and migration kit updated, server restarted and policy choices verified. The full-suite fixture expectation was corrected to use current configured provider slots. This completes the selector foundation only; multi-provider pool, approved data scopes and measured model ranking remain open.

Theme-aware, keyboard-contained, narrow-screen and plain-text fallback support. Independently disableable. P2 · WIP — Compact message navigation markers

Extend the existing navigation rail with a narrow strip and ten-pixel marker rhythm. Short chats must not spread markers across the whole screen; dense chats stay within the gutter. Retain previews, bookmarks, keyboard navigation and click-to-jump. Remark: local browser checks passed; source workflows and installed verification pending.

P2 · WIP — Subtle askbar glow during generation

Theme-aware border light while the visible chat prepares a reply; stop immediately on completion/cancel/error or idle-chat navigation. Appearance off switch persists per browser. Reduced motion uses a steady border; hidden tabs pause animation. No glow on file import alone, no flashing/rotating gradients; independently disableable. Remark: implementation under browser/CI validation; not completed yet.
